# TwitSticker (gifsticker.site)

> Free online Twitter & X video to WhatsApp animated sticker converter. Turn viral Twitter/X videos, animated GIFs, and memes into transparent 512x512 animated WhatsApp stickers under 500 KB in 1 click.

## Core Capabilities
- **Twitter & X to WhatsApp Sticker Conversion**: Converts videos and animated GIFs from Twitter/X links into official 512x512 WebP animated stickers compliant with WhatsApp's strict size limit (< 500 KB).
- **Embedded WhatsApp EXIF Metadata**: Injects custom sticker pack name, publisher author, and emoji tags into the WebP container for native WhatsApp keyboard recognition.
- **WhatsApp Web & Desktop Drag-and-Drop**: 1-click download of .webp sticker files that drag and drop directly into WhatsApp Web chat to send as true animated stickers.
- **Mobile 1-Tap Share & Add**: Native Web Share API integration to send stickers directly to WhatsApp on Android and iOS, ready to tap "Add to Favorites" (⭐) to save to the sticker keyboard.
- **Direct Sticker Sharing**: Every converted sticker generates a shareable link at `https://gifsticker.site/sticker/<id>` with rich OpenGraph preview cards for social messaging apps.
- **File Upload Support**: Convert local MP4, WebM, MOV, and GIF files directly without needing a Twitter link.

## Technical Specifications for WhatsApp Stickers
- Resolution: Exactly 512x512 pixels
- Format: Animated WebP (`image/webp`) with alpha transparency
- Max Size: Under 500 KB total file size
- Frame Rate: Optimized 9-16 FPS
- Max Duration: 3.5 seconds recommended for smooth infinite loop
